what: The Python of the frozen AWS Lambda work of 2026-09-28, of the regression workers frozen on 2026-09-29 and of the teacher campaign's second stage (2026-09-29), the four files that only serve that Python, and the teacher campaign's C pilot, preserved byte-exact in custody instead of being tracked. deploy/lambda/SNAPSHOT.json lists every file of those bodies; this manifest is the restore record for the ones in custody.
why: Owner rule of 2026-09-26: the stack is Rust, and no Python is added to the tree. Owner decision of 2026-09-29 ~00:15Z: the Lambda Rust goes into PR #124 and is built and tested by CI; the Lambda Python and other untracked orchestration is preserved byte-exact in custody with this tracked hash manifest. Owner decision of 2026-09-29 ~04:20Z (O1): PR #125 imports the frozen regression workers under the same rule. Owner ruling of 2026-09-29 (about 08:20Z): the teacher campaign's second stage is rolled into the repository; PR #129 imports it under the same rule, and keeps its C pilot in custody too, outside the Rust, bash and jq stack.
follow_up: Port these tools to Rust (the deploy, invoke, budget, archive and close controllers, the corpus inventory and curation, the analysis and plots, the monitor feed adapter and launcher, the planning tools, and the regression run's audit, history index, input preparation, campaign, accounting, query-table, reconcile and closeout tools, and the teacher campaign's coordinator, its transport and budget helpers, its control analysis, report and protocol tests), then retire this custody record.
restore: On xbabe2: tar -xf ~/jope-evidence/lambda-20260929/python/<custody_tarball> -C <new directory>; then, in that directory, sha256sum -c --strict ~/jope-evidence/lambda-20260929/python/FILES.sha256. Each member path starts with its source directory name (lambda-csv/, lambda-watch/, gp-evolution-100/). The regression tarballs have their own list: after extracting lambda-python-regression.tar and lambda-python-regression-ops.tar, run sha256sum -c --strict ~/jope-evidence/lambda-20260929/python/FILES-regression.sha256; their member paths start with regression-lambda-v3/ or regression-lambda-v3-ops/. The teacher-v2 tarball has its own list: after extracting lambda-python-teacher-v2.tar, run sha256sum -c --strict ~/jope-evidence/lambda-20260929/python/FILES-teacher-v2.sha256; its member paths start with test-adaptive-gp-islands-v2/.
